name: com.jamsql/jam-sql-studio
title: Jam SQL Studio
description: Lets AI agents query SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle and SQLite via the Jam SQL Studio app.

environmentVariables.name: JAMSQL_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: MCP endpoint of the running Jam SQL Studio app. Leave unset to find it automatically through ~/.jamsql/mcp-discovery.json.

environmentVariables.name: JAMSQL_MCP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token from Settings → AI Integrations. Leave unset to use the token saved by `jam-sql pair`.
